name: 8-Bit Orbit 像素轨道
description: 任务地图、关卡门、Boss 判断、道具栏、技能树与像素场景
source: ClawHive-authored style card; no external vendor assets included.
pptFallback: 复杂 CSS 效果改为静态填充、渐变或烘焙背景，文字和形状保持原生

typography.title_stack: Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif
typography.title_stack_ppt: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif

behavior: 气质：游戏化、冒险、进取；视觉语汇：像素颗粒、任务地图节点、黄紫道具栏；装饰：nodes, gates, item bars and small pixel stars；构图：sequence and decision path over decorative game UI
taboos: 避免把严肃结论游戏化
像素字体只用于短标签
coverStructure: pixel title with one quest/map anchor
sectionStructure: chapters behave as levels with clear progress marker
titleTreatment: pixel display title plus plain readable subtitle
decorativeLanguage: nodes, gates, item bars and small pixel stars
bodyCompositionBias: sequence and decision path over decorative game UI
